items.title: Trump escalates feud with Merz, threatens troop cuts in Germany

featured_image.name: Trump in Fresh Attack on Germany's Merz Over Iran

items.description: President Donald Trump escalated a public dispute with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Thursday, telling the German leader to focus on ending the Russia-Ukraine war and fixing his "broken Country" rather than "interfering" with American efforts against Iran. The broadside came one day after Trump announced the U.S. was "studying and reviewing the possible reduction of Troops in Germany," raising the prospect of a drawdown from one of America's most strategically vital overseas military footprints.[1][2]

items.title: Alleged killer of 5yo girl moved to Darwin after violent clashes outside hospital
items.description: Kumanjayi Little Baby's alleged killer Jefferson Lewis, 47, has been flown to Darwin after violent clashes outside the Alice Springs hospital he had been in.

items.title: Iran's Khamenei vows to defend nuclear capabilities after Trump-Putin call

featured_image.name: What to know about Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei

items.description:
President Donald Trump on Wednesday disclosed that Russian President Vladimir Putin had offered to help resolve the standoff over Iran's enriched uranium stockpile during a 90-minute phone call, but said he told Putin he would prefer the Kremlin prioritize ending its war in Ukraine.

"He told me he'd like to be involved with the enrichment — if he can help us get it," Trump told reporters in the Oval Office on April 29. "I said, 'I'd much rather have you be involved with ending the war with Ukraine.' To me, that would be more important."[1][2]

items.title: Zelenskyy demands details on Victory Day ceasefire after Trump-Putin call

featured_image.name: Russian President Vladimir Putin agrees to face-to-face talks with Ukraine

items.description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke by phone on Wednesday, April 29, in a conversation lasting more than 90 minutes that ended with Putin proposing a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine to mark Russia's May 9 Victory Day holiday — and competing claims over who originated the idea.

items.title: Trump says US reviewing troop reduction in Germany

featured_image.name: US reviewing potential reduction of troops in Germany: Trump

items.description:
President Donald Trump announced on Wednesday that his administration is reviewing a possible reduction of American military forces stationed in Germany, escalating pressure on NATO allies who have refused to support the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. "The United States is studying and reviewing the possible reduction of Troops in Germany, with a determination to be made over the next short period of time," Trump wrote on Truth Social.[1][2][3]

The move comes amid a growing transatlantic rift. The U.S. currently has just over 68,000 active-duty military personnel permanently assigned to bases across Europe, with more than half — about 36,400 — stationed in Germany, according to data from the U.S. Defense Manpower Data Center cited by Reuters.[2]

items.title: Israel sets two-week deadline for Lebanon deal, warns of escalation

featured_image.name: Donald Trump tells Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu to ease Lebanon strikes

items.description: Israel has given US-mediated negotiations with Lebanon a two-week window to produce a permanent agreement, warning it will resume intensive military operations against Hezbollah if diplomacy fails by mid-May, according to multiple reports citing Israeli officials.

items.title: Trump calls UAE's exit from OPEC 'great' for fuel prices

featured_image.name: Trump welcomes UAE's decision to leave OPEC, says it will lower prices

items.description:
President Donald Trump on Wednesday welcomed the United Arab Emirates' decision to withdraw from OPEC, calling the move "great" and framing it as a win for American consumers grappling with surging fuel costs amid the ongoing war with Iran.

"I think it's great," Trump told reporters. "Ultimately, it's a good thing for getting the price of gas down, getting oil down, getting everything down." Trump, who has previously accused OPEC of "ripping off the rest of the world," also praised UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed, calling him "a great leader" and adding, "He probably maybe wants to go his own way. That's a good thing."[1]

items.title: London stabbing of 2 Jewish men declared terrorist attack

featured_image.name: Two injured in stabbing attack in North London

items.description:
Two Jewish men were stabbed on the streets of north London on Wednesday morning in what police have formally declared a terrorist incident, marking the latest in a series of antisemitic attacks to strike the capital's Jewish community.

The attack occurred at approximately 11:16 a.m. on Highfield Avenue in Barnet, near Golders Green, a neighborhood home to one of London's largest Jewish populations. The victims, aged 76 and 34, suffered knife wounds and were taken to hospital, where they are reported to be in stable condition.[1][2][3]

items.title: Perovskite device sets records as both solar cell and LED

featured_image.name: UNIST, EPFL claim 25.6% efficiency world record for perovskite solar cell –  pv magazine International

items.description: A single perovskite device has achieved world-record performance in both solar energy conversion and light emission, a feat that had previously been accomplished only by costly single-crystal gallium arsenide. The study, published in Joule, describes a diode that converts sunlight to electricity at 26.7% efficiency and emits light with an external quantum efficiency of roughly 31%, demonstrating that the long-standing divide between photovoltaic and LED device design is an engineering problem rather than a physical limitation.[1][2]
